limits: Author source-informed legal control plans are replayed through public UI; they establish reachable wins and regressions, not unaided discovery or human difficulty.

Desktop campaign game actions use native focused buttons with Enter/Space and native range keyboard input. Mobile campaign game actions use actual touchscreen taps, including native range aiming; no keyboard or writable game-state hooks. Native selectOption is used only to choose the optional mode before its touch gameplay.
Mobile is 390px touch emulation, with 320px responsive checks, not a physical phone or screen-reader certification.
All physics is turn-paced with fixed substeps and simplified documented game models; no engineering or sports prediction claim.

Optional-mode UI evidence includes exactly two fresh generated challenge wins, banked cumulative score, player end-run, and a separate generated-run natural loss/restart; unbounded-stage and differing-seed model properties are separate source assertions.
